description: What changed in cloud server pricing recently: new instance types or regions (new), delisted (removed), price increases/cuts (price_up/price_down), and sale prices against an unchanged list price (discount/discount_end). new/removed are whole instance types; a type appearing in or leaving one region is available/unavailable (only when asked). Recorded at each daily sync in the native currency (FX moves are not changes); hourly prices with USD equivalents. Newest first, biggest moves first.

days.description: look back this many days (default 7, max 90)

instance_type.description: substring of the instance type, e.g. c7 or a100

kind.description: new, removed, price_up, price_down, discount, discount_end, available, or unavailable; omit for all but available/unavailable (region-level stock churn)

name: price_changes
title: Recent price changes
